<!--ocr2md:latex id=9006176949b442d8 review=latex-->
```math
L _ {t} = \frac {\mathsf {T A} _ {t} ^ {M V} - \mathsf {C a s h} _ {t} ^ {M V}}{\mathsf {E q u i t y} _ {t} ^ {M V}},
```
<!--/ocr2md:latex id=9006176949b442d8-->

<!--ocr2md:latex id=a4cc78ca1e134c22 review=latex-->
```math
\mathsf {T A} _ {t} ^ {M V} = \mathsf {T A} _ {t} ^ {B V} + \mathsf {E q u i t y} _ {t} ^ {M V} - \mathsf {E q u i t y} _ {t} ^ {B V}.
```
<!--/ocr2md:latex id=a4cc78ca1e134c22-->

<!--ocr2md:latex id=00facb6ab6bd41c9 review=latex-->
```math
\text { Private } _ {t} ^ {M V} = \text { TA } _ {t} ^ {M V} - \text { Public } _ {t} ^ {M V} - \text { Cash } _ {t} ^ {M V}.
```
<!--/ocr2md:latex id=00facb6ab6bd41c9-->

<!--ocr2md:latex id=c3be6f9c004148da review=latex-->
```math
\begin{array}{l} r _ {t + 1} ^ {\text {Private}} = \frac {\Delta \text {Private} _ {t + 1} ^ {M V}}{\text {Private} _ {t} ^ {M V}} \\ = \frac {r _ {t + 1} ^ {f} \text {Liabilities} _ {t} ^ {M V} + r _ {t + 1} ^ {\text {Equity}} \text {Equity} _ {t} ^ {M V} - r _ {t + 1} ^ {\text {Public}} \text {Public} _ {t} ^ {M V} - r _ {t + 1} ^ {f} \text {Cash} _ {t} ^ {M V}}{\text {Private} _ {t} ^ {M V}}, \end{array}
```
<!--/ocr2md:latex id=c3be6f9c004148da-->

<!--ocr2md:latex id=0e4ebdbf5af845e7 review=latex-->
```math
\text { Liabilities } _ {t} ^ {M V} = \text { TA } _ {t} ^ {M V} - \text { Equity } _ {t} ^ {M V}.
```
<!--/ocr2md:latex id=0e4ebdbf5af845e7-->

<!--ocr2md:latex id=1c5d934e22414c9c review=latex-->
```math
\begin{array}{l} r _ {t + 1} ^ {\text {Equity}} - r _ {t + 1} ^ {f} = \\ \left[ w _ {t} \Big (r _ {t + 1} ^ {\text {Private}} - r _ {t + 1} ^ {f} \Big) + (1 - w _ {t}) \Big (r _ {t + 1} ^ {\text {Public}} - r _ {t + 1} ^ {f} \Big) \right] L _ {t}. \end{array}
```
<!--/ocr2md:latex id=1c5d934e22414c9c-->

where <!--ocr2md:latex id="188702e91c0d468f" review="latex" delimited="auto-inline" padBefore="1" padAfter="1"-->$\mathsf { T A } \_ { t }$<!--/ocr2md:latex id="188702e91c0d468f"--> is total assets, Cash\<sub>t\</sub> is cash that Berkshire Hathaway owns, and Equity is Berkshire’s equity value. The superscript MV is market value. We computed this measure of leverage for each month. We wanted to compute the leverage always using market values, but for some variables, we could observe only book values (indicated with superscript BV). We considered the market value of Berkshire’s equity to be the stock price multiplied by the shares outstanding. Cash holdings are from Berkshire’s consolidated balance sheet (see Appendix A). The balance sheet also provides the book value of the total assets,<!--ocr2md:latex id="b6f22d03f62742d3" review="latex" delimited="auto-inline"-->$\mathsf { T A } \_ { t } ^ { B V }$<!--/ocr2md:latex id="b6f22d03f62742d3"-->, and the book value of equity, value of the total assets as
